Try it now and connect idealista with your Claude.

_published_faq.name: How do I add idealista to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add idealista to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp-app.idealista.com/claude/v1/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is idealista MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 5, 2026, idealista scores 0/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and does not yet meet Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the idealista MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: idealista provides these MCP tools: get_howto, guide_idealista_assistant, property_detail, and search_properties.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to idealista?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to idealista in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, PHS Pallets, Promotion Pros Catalog, and RCO-A2A.
idealista does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.

_published_faq.name: Why is idealista failing MCP readiness checks?

acceptedAnswer.text: idealista scored 0/100 on the latest Manufact MCP publishing checklist, below the 70-point checklist threshold. The top failing check is Authenticated MCP access is available. Reconnect the server account or provide a valid refreshable OAuth session, then rerun the audit. Paste the MCP URL into the Manufact MCP catalog to rerun the scan.
